entries.name: Beast Boy
entries.sourceReference: Teen Titans (2003), Beast Boy: Final Exam transcript/indexed excerpt explicitly describes Beast Boy as a T-rex. Only eight complete green Tyrannosaurus poses are retained for fatality/super; all six human rows in the original source are rejected and are not exposed as phases. These are adapted generated poses, not official episode frames.
entries.identityCorrection: Only the eight complete green T-Rex poses are retained. All six humanoid rows were rejected because their head/body proportions do not match the requested 2003 series; a native correction was refused. No humanoid row is exposed by this partial atlas.

statureReview.reason: Separate complete green T-Rex reference, not a human proportion comparison. The largest upright native T-Rex reference maps to an authored220px head-to-foot canvas scale; tail/body remain whole and all other native animal crouches retain their source height ratios. This does not certify canonical world size.
